title: ecgrobust: a framework for evaluating wearable ECG classifiers under real-world noise
description: Code for the study evaluating how single-lead AF classifiers (rule-based, logistic regression, gradient boosting, 1-D CNN) degrade under real recorded noise from the MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database, with external validation on PTB-XL lead I, noise augmentation, and quality-based abstention.
